trigger: Full-pool financing sweep (see financing-evidence-ledger-06.json for the zero-hit majority and full methodology). These 23 candidates had at least one 424B/S-1/S-3/8-K-Item-3.02 filing land inside their T-90-to-T+30 window; each was individually fetched and read to confirm it represents an actual primary issuance or debt draw with real proceeds to the issuer (not a resale-only registration, a bare shelf registration with no accompanying takedown, or a same-shareholder share-for-warrant exchange with no new capital).
qualification_rule: Count only actual issuer equity, equity-linked, or debt capital raised from T-90 through T+30. Theoretical shelf or ATM registration capacity without actual issuance is not sufficient, and a registration statement covering the resale of already-outstanding shares by existing holders is not company financing.

Follow-up 8-Ks (2019-12-06, 2020-01-02) report deal-closing progress on the same transaction.
